name: Debt ~Abunai President~
source:
Hazama's father gets hospitalized suddenly and leaves him as the company president of a sinking corporation in debt. Can he pull it together with the help of secretary, Rendou, in time to save the company?

[From Aarinfantasy]
translation:
間的父親突然住院，把一家負債累累、瀕臨倒閉的公司和總裁職位留給了他。在秘書蓮堂的幫助下，他能否及時扭轉局勢，拯救公司？

[摘自Aarinfantasy]
